'''2022 MPC Lenny Rubin LS Diplo''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Lenny Rubin]] at [[2022 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Lenny Rubin]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan / A Weakness Can Be Found|V3-L-diplomaticmissiontoalderaan.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Diplomatic Mission To Aldera Rubin.txt |Download]]
